backPanel.description: Hand-harvested from mature moringa trees nurtured in the mineral-rich volcanic soils of Mount Kenya's foothills. Shade-dried below 40°C to preserve heat-sensitive enzymes, chlorophyll, and vital bioflavonoids.
backPanel.activeConstituents: Bioavailable Iron, Quercetin, Kaempferol, Chlorogenic Acid, Natural Vitamin C
backPanel.ritualDirections: Whisk 1 level teaspoon (5g) into 200ml warm spring water, fresh fruit juice, or morning smoothie. Best savored at sunrise.
backPanel.cautions: Consult your physician prior to use if pregnant, nursing, or taking blood sugar/blood pressure pharmaceuticals.
backPanel.storage: Reseal tightly. Store in a cool, dark apothecary cabinet away from direct sunlight.

backPanel.description: Wildcrafted from centuries-old coastal Kenyan baobab trees. The fruit naturally dehydrates on the branch under equatorial sunshine, yielding an unheated raw superfood containing over 50% prebiotic soluble dietary fiber.
backPanel.activeConstituents: Prebiotic Soluble Pectin, L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Potassium, Calcium, Bioflavonoids
backPanel.ritualDirections: Stir 1 tablespoon (10g) briskly into spring water, chilled coconut water, or yogurt. Tart and refreshing citrus-sherbet profile.
backPanel.cautions: Safe for the entire family under normal dietary consumption.
backPanel.storage: Keep airtight. Naturally hygroscopic; protect from humidity.

frontPanel.title: Cold-Pressed High-Altitude Marula Glow Elixir
frontPanel.claim: Lipid Barrier Restoration & Luminous Antioxidant Veil

backPanel.description: Cold-pressed from wild marula kernels harvested by rural women's collectives in Kenya's semi-arid scrublands. A non-comedogenic elixir rich in essential Omegas 6 & 9 that locks in deep hydration and shields delicate skin barriers.
backPanel.activeConstituents: Oleic Acid (Omega-9), Linoleic Acid (Omega-6), Natural Tocopherols (Vitamin E), Phytosterols
backPanel.ritualDirections: Warm 3 to 5 drops between clean fingertips. Press mindfully into clean, damp facial skin morning and night.
backPanel.cautions: Nut allergy warning: Contains tree nut derivatives. Perform patch test 24 hours prior to full use.
backPanel.storage: Store upright in protective violet glass bottle below 25°C.

backPanel.description: Cultivated in high-altitude volcanic loam at the base of Mount Kenya. Slow sun-cured and enhanced with black pepper piperine to maximize curcuminoid absorption and soothe daily physical strain.
backPanel.ritualDirections: Whisk 1/2 teaspoon (3g) into warm coconut or oat milk with a dash of raw honey. Simmer for 3 minutes for Golden Milk.
backPanel.cautions: Avoid during acute gallstones or bile obstruction. Consult doctor if taking anticoagulant therapy.
backPanel.storage: Keep lid tightly closed to preserve pungent volatile oils.

frontPanel.partUsed: Hand-picked whole dried calyces & highland lemongrass

backPanel.description: Hand-harvested crimson calyces blended with wild highland lemongrass. Infuses into a vibrant ruby-red tonic overflowing with natural anthocyanins, fruit acids, and delicate citrus aromatics.
backPanel.ritualDirections: Steep 1 tablespoon (5g) in 350ml boiling water (95°C) for 6 to 8 minutes. Savor hot or pour over ice with fresh mint.
backPanel.cautions: Consult physician if managing hypotension (low blood pressure) or during early pregnancy.
backPanel.storage: Store in a cool dry pantry away from spices with strong aromas.
